title: IncidentEvent
description: Hybrid schema for incidents.received Kafka topic. Universal fields first-class; origin-specific payload preserved verbatim in payload_raw.

received_at.description: Timestamp when the gateway received the event (UTC, ISO 8601).

opened_at.description: Timestamp when the incident was opened in the originating system (UTC, ISO 8601).

entity_id.description: Identifier of the affected IC, host, or service.

status.description: Current status of the incident in the originating system.

payload_raw.description: Full original event as JSON string, verbatim from the originating system.
